contract: For local captures, every explicitly declared repository name or repository ID in the retained source snapshot and producer must agree exactly with the observation.
A self-consistent source digest cannot repair a contradictory repository label or substitute float/bool/string IDs for the observation's positive integer identity.
Preserve legacy local captures without optional repository metadata, existing provider projection, stream binding, source/clock checks and nonauthoritative result format.
Acceptance still proves only internal integrity and arithmetic. Missing repository declarations never become authenticated facts, matched cohort eligibility, baseline approval or provider authority.

Reject contradictions in the existing pure acceptance owner before later baseline aggregation; do not introduce a second capture validator, authority flag, receipt family or caller-selected repository override.
Keep immutable original captures unchanged; regenerate mirrors only through the canonical owner.
positive_tests: Original valid local/provider captures remain byte-identical and accepted within their existing narrow scope.
Explicit correct local source/producer repository metadata is accepted without conferring authority.
negative_controls: Wrong local source repository or ID with a correctly recomputed snapshot digest is rejected.
Wrong producer metadata cannot hide behind an explicit consistent source snapshot.
An ID numerically equal to the observation but represented as float/string is not silently repaired.
forbidden: Active primary submission bytes or transaction state
New source authentication or matched/statistical performance claims
Provider writes, maintained adopters or immutable custody mutation
integration: Isolated until the active primary transaction has an authenticated terminal and scoped source/runtime parity passes. All whole requirements stay open.

contract: Extend the existing combined installed consumer probe; source package absent under isolated Python.
Consume immutable original capture JSON as input data, not source imports; read schemas from the actual installed consumer.
Accept the unchanged legacy capture, reject each contradictory source/producer identity type and preserve authority false.
Keep real compiler, durable evidence, archive/ref negative controls and schema preservation in the same existing fixture.
installed_verification.execution: Defer full installed execution until actual primary transaction terminal and native admission.
